sources: Microsoft Learn: Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor: maximum average CPU load of a scan, 5 to 100 or 0 (no limit), default 50. Not a hard limit; for idle scans the value does not apply as long as DisableCpuThrottleOnIdleScans is on (default).

Microsoft Learn: WMI class MSFT_MpPreference (root\Microsoft\Windows\Defender) with the Set method. The only Defender setting Ascended Tweaks touches; real-time protection and all protection features stay unchanged. If a policy sets the value (Scan\AvgCPULoadFactor), the tweak is not available.
